figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. (A) Structures of (−)-sativene, (−)-isosativene, and (−)-longifolene. The oxidation and bond cleavage sites are indicated by dark red
circles and dashed lines, respectively. (B) Strategy for the chemical synthesis of (−)-longifolene-related sesquiterpenoids. (C) General biosynthetic
pathway of sesquiterpenoids. (D) Characterized sesquiterpenoids are presented according to their carbon skeletons, and the new structures are
shown with red numbers. Crystal structures of 3 and 21 are shown. (E) The inhibitory curve of 15 on LPS-induced NO release in RAW264.7
macrophages. (F) The organization of bip BGC.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Characterization of BipA. (A) GC-MS analysis of in vitro biochemical reactions of BipA and standards. (B) 1H NMR spectra of in vitro
biochemical reaction of BipA and standards. (C) Proposed cyclization mechanism of BipA. (D) Computed (mPW1PW91/6-311+G(d,p)//
B3LYP/6-31+G(d,p)) relative free energies (kcal/mol, italics) of the BipA-catalyzed cyclization pathway. The black lines and numbers represent
energies, transition states (TS), and intermediates (INT) calculated for 1,10-closure pathway, and red lines and numbers represent those for the
1,11-closure pathway. RC indicates reactant compound.
